title: A2P Messaging Explained: Why Business Texting Keeps Getting Harder
summary: A2P messaging was built to stop spam, but it has become a structural constraint on business text messaging. Learn what A2P is, why it limits SMS marketing software, and how iMessage avoids it.
body_markdown:
A2P messaging is not broken. It is simply optimized for a different era of communication. If your business text messaging strategy relies on SMS marketing software, A2P messaging will continue to impose friction, delays, and unpredictability. If your messaging strategy is built on iMessage, those constraints largely disappear.


Sendblue allows businesses to move beyond A2P messaging limitations without sacrificing scale, compliance, or operational flexibility. That is why businesses serious about engagement and reliability are choosing iMessage-based messaging over traditional A2P-restricted SMS platforms.
